title: "Data Governance"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

This is a private health dataset. No data can be shared outside of authorized parties.
This also means that any visualizations and tables must be strictly masked.

At present, this is enforced by project access on GitHub and by
data access on FASRC. The project does originate from before TMT
joined the team, so a lot of retroactive engineering is likely.
